newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujita Corp falls again on debt rumours.
newsitem.headline: Fujita Corp falls again on debt rumours.

text.p: Fujita Corp shares continued to trickle lower on Friday morning, as investors were still said to be worried about recent, unfounded rumours about the firm's financial health, brokers said.
As of 0145 GMT, the shares were down 31 points at 226 on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.

The shares were knocked lower on Thursday on rumours that the firm may have guaranteed some debts of Kyotaru Corp, a sushi chain operator which last weekend filed for court protection from creditors, brokers said.
A spokesman at Fujita, a second-tier general contractor, denied the market rumours.
"We have nothing to do with Kyotaru, not even as a debt guarantor," he said.
